about:
AutoTecknic USA operates from Rosemead, California, where it designs and manufactures carbon fiber composite upgrades for luxury performance vehicles. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it has built a catalog of aftermarket parts that span exterior aero components, interior trim, steering wheel upgrades, and lifestyle accessories.

The product line includes pre-preg and dry carbon fiber parts such as front grilles, spoilers, mirror caps, engine covers, and shift paddles, as well as CNC-machined 6061-T6 hard-anodized billet aluminum components. Manufacturing processes combine aerospace-grade pre-preg carbon fiber layup with precision machining, and the company states it holds ISO 9001 certification for quality management. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

AutoTecknic serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting owners of BMW, Audi, Ferrari, Honda, Lamborghini, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, Nissan, and the Toyota A90 Supra. Its parts are listed by specific chassis codes (e.g., BMW G87 M2, G80 M3, Porsche 992) and the company also stocks products from partner brands such as Akrapovic, BBS, KW Suspensions, and Recaro.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: ISO 9001-certified quality control with a one-year replacement warranty on defective products, same-day shipping on stocked items, and a design philosophy aimed at increasing aerodynamic performance, vehicle stability, and visual appeal. These claims are presented on its website alongside a disclaimer that it has no affiliation with the original vehicle manufacturers.
